evidence_test: cd referee && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_revert.py'  # Rule.test_one_red_inside_the_set_is_test_regression, Rule.test_repeated_ids_change_nothing, Rule.test_equal_or_lower_lint_is_not_a_rise, Rule.test_unknown, Shapes.*, Revert.test_red_tests_are_the_sentinels, Revert.test_build_break_reverts_with_build_break, Revert.test_not_red_sends_nothing. 29j cause leaves these open; my choices, each bound by a test: (a) A red set with tests both inside and outside the impact set is test_regression (literal 'bir kirmizi test kumede', first rule that holds); a reader could want impact_miss whenever any red test is outside, which would change the order of rules 3 and 4 and needs saying in 29j. (b) red_tests and impact are read as sets: a repeated id is accepted and changes nothing (no contradiction, unlike a repeated id in a sentinel run). (c) Shapes are exact: stdin only {red_tests, impact, build_ok, lint}; ids non-empty strings; build_ok a JSON bool; lint {tool: {before, after}} with a non-empty tool name and non-negative integers (a bool or 1.0 is not one); anything else exit 2 with {cause: null}. (d) An equal count is not a rise; a tool present on only one side cannot be expressed (each tool carries both counts); 29j does not say whether a tool new at the head counts from 0. (e) The sentinel's red with no result in any judged run has red [], so its cause is build_break when build_ok is false and unknown otherwise. (f) Not in the seed, as 29j states: the producers of build_ok and of the sentinel's lint totals; gate.revert.revert_red takes them as facts and takes red_tests from sentinel.decide itself (calls 12 -> 13), so the cause cannot be computed over a red set the sentinel did not verify. (g) The merge of the revert's pull request is the gate's (tohum/07 'kapidan gecer'); revert_red opens it and stops. Draft for 29j: '(a) kumede bir kirmizi test varsa test_regression, digerleri disarida olsa da; (b) kimlik listeleri kumedir; (c) bicimler tam, sayilar negatif olmayan tamsayi; (d) bir araci yalniz bir tarafta olan girdi kullanilamaz.' and for 26a gate.revert: name who produces build_ok and the lint totals at the red head.
